privileged_info_for_vlm: The ground station 'Galapagos_Reserve' must have Latitude -0.38 and Longitude -90.30 (South and West are negative in GPredict). The required satellites and their NORAD IDs are: SENTINEL-1A (39634), SENTINEL-2A (40697), SENTINEL-2B (42028), LANDSAT 8 (39084), and LANDSAT 9 (49260). Note that in this environment, NORAD ID 42028 is synthetically mapped to SENTINEL-2B. The map must be centered at -90 longitude.
